skill.name: receipt-scanner-master
skill.description: Guide receipt OCR, expense categorization, parsing validation, and database troubleshooting for a local finance application.
skill.summary: Scan receipts, verify OCR results, and connect extracted items to expense records.
skill.author: EGAdams

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, localhost examples, placeholder API key setup, and normal receipt database checks. No evidence of prompt injection, secret exfiltration, malicious network activity, or executable backtick evaluation was found.

static_findings.snippet: - `/api/parse-receipt` - Uploads and parses receipt image (returns temp data, doesn't save)
- `/api/save-receipt` - Final save for categorized items (batch operation)
- `expenses` - Main expense entries (amount, date, category, method)
- Check `quantity × unit_price = line_total` for each item
- ✓ Items with categories selected → Saved to `expenses` table
- Add per-item tax tracking in `ReceiptItem` model
- Validate: `sum(item.tax_amount for item in items) = totals.tax_amount`
- Flash model used first to avoid pro quota limits
SELECT * FROM expenses ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM receipt_metadata ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;
# Verify category_id assignments in parsed items
# Items without category_id are not saved to database

content.value_statement: Receipt processing often needs OCR checks, category review, and database validation. This skill guides receipt parsing, troubleshooting, and expense record workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains the receipt upload and parsing workflow for images, PDFs, and WebP files.
Guides validation of merchant details, line items, totals, taxes, and payment methods.
Documents category selection behavior and database save rules for receipt items.
Provides troubleshooting steps for OCR errors, upload failures, and timeout issues.
Identifies related backend, frontend, configuration, and test files for maintenance.
limitations: Requires the local receipt scanner application and API routes described by the skill.
Does not provide an OCR model or receipt database by itself.
Accuracy depends on image quality and the configured Gemini model.
Examples use local development paths that may need adjustment.

use_cases.title: Review Scanned Receipts
use_cases.description: Validate extracted merchant data, line items, categories, and totals before saving expenses.

use_cases.title: Debug OCR Problems
use_cases.description: Investigate incorrect prices, missing items, unclear images, and model quota errors.

use_cases.title: Improve Receipt Workflows
use_cases.description: Update prompts, validation checks, image processing, and database integration for receipt handling.

prompt_templates.title: Scan One Receipt
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me scan this receipt and explain which fields I should verify before saving it.

prompt_templates.title: Check OCR Accuracy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the parsed receipt data with the source image and list any likely OCR mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Saving
prompt_templates.prompt: The receipt parsed correctly, but items did not save. Trace the category and database workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance Receipt Parsing
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the receipt parser and prompt rules, then propose changes to improve item extraction accuracy.

output_examples.input: A grocery receipt parsed with a wrong total amount.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists mismatched totals, likely OCR causes, and validation checks to run next.

output_examples.input: A user cannot find saved receipt items after categorizing them.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains the item save workflow and identifies database records to verify.

output_examples.input: A developer wants better parsing for blurry receipts.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends image preprocessing, prompt updates, and focused regression tests.

best_practices: Use clear, well-lit receipt images before debugging OCR behavior.
Validate totals and line items before saving categorized expenses.
Keep problematic receipts as regression samples for parser changes.
anti_patterns: Do not save parsed receipt data without reviewing categories and totals.
Do not treat uncategorized items as saved expense records.
Do not paste real API keys into shared prompts or logs.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps parse receipts, validate OCR output, categorize items, and troubleshoot database saves.

faq.question: Does it scan receipts by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides a local application that performs receipt upload, OCR, and database storage.

faq.question: Which AI model does it reference?
faq.answer: The skill describes a Gemini-based receipt engine with model fallback for quota handling.

faq.question: Are receipt items saved automatically?
faq.answer: Only categorized items are saved according to the documented workflow.

faq.question: Can it help with OCR mistakes?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents common digit, total, image quality, and missing item issues.

faq.question: Is it tied to one project layout?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples reference specific local paths and application files.
